svg.title: Rounding weights to 16 values
svg.desc: One row of a query projection of the 0.5B model, 896 weights. Each orange line is a value that 4 bits can name.
svg.text: One row of a query projection of the 0.5B model, 896 weights. Each orange line is a value that 4 bits can name.
The whole row shares one scale
16 values from the row's smallest weight to its largest, 0.036 apart. Most weights share the few in the middle.
A group of 64 weights has a scale of its own
16 values over the range of this group alone, 0.023 apart. Rounding moves a weight by at most half a step.
The row's range is 1.5 times that of its average group. The price of groups is a scale and an offset for each.
